premises.text: SMB international shippers depend on freight brokers whose quotes take days, hide fees, charge fat margins, and vanish when things go wrong
premises.evidence_span: it takes days to get quotes that are full of hidden fees

premises.text: Shipster gives transparent rated access to trucking, warehouse, customs, and ocean providers with unified documents and communication
premises.evidence_span: Shipster provides you transparent access to those service providers

premises.text: Automated multi-provider quoting and booking completes in minutes and saves 30% to 60% versus broker-mediated shipping
premises.evidence_span: what takes days, Shipster does in minutes

premises.text: Ocean-carrier reliability scores are built from aggregated public customs performance data
premises.evidence_span: we've aggregated public customs data to see how this carrier has performed over time

premises.text: Initial go-to-market focuses on Ningbo–Los Angeles, targeting SMB electronics and textile importers identifiable via customs data and a call center
premises.evidence_span: Shipster is focusing on Ningbo, China, the seventh busiest port in the world, to Los Angeles, California

premises.text: A sister site lets service providers onboard, update pricing, and manage shipments
premises.evidence_span: Shipster has a sister site that allows service providers to be onboarded, update their pricing, and manage their shipments

value.text: Small businesses get faster, cheaper, transparent international ocean shipping
value.evidence_span: we save you 30% to 60% in the process
